title: Taiwanese Students Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese Students Association (TSA) at Carnegie Mellon University is a student organization serving the Taiwanese and Taiwanese American undergraduate community in Pittsburgh. The organization is registered with CMU’s official club platform, TartanConnect, and maintains an active presence across Facebook and Instagram, where it operates under the handle @cmu_tsa with over 1,000 followers and more than 450 posts as of 2025.

TSA participates regularly in CMU campus life, including the annual Spring Carnival, where it has collaborated with other cultural organizations such as the Hong Kong Student Association on shared Carnival booth projects. The group holds recurring events including a SpeedFriending social, an annual ski trip, and a club fair presence in the Cohon University Center. The organization describes itself as open to anyone interested in Taiwanese culture, not exclusively students from Taiwan.
